notes.title: Mercury Blue: Mini-Episode Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've updated Mercury Blue: Mini-Episode with the following improvements:

- Improved load times for all scenes: previously textures and resources were taking a long time to load before scenes became active.  Optimisations have now been put in place to improve load times.

- Fixed bug when exiting door:  A gap in the ship door colliders was "trapping" the player character, preventing them from exiting the ship.  This has now been fixed.    

- Volume adjustments: certain music and sound effects were quite loud by default.  These have now been normalised.

- Improved path finding algorithm: certain objects were blocking hotspots when attempting to traverse the current scene.  This has now been rectified.

- Various (minor) tweaks to graphics, audio and dialog
